notablePrerequisites: You have at least {E} or enough mana to cast Dream Stalker
description:
Cast Dream Stalker by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers, if able, or by paying its mana cost.
When Dream Stalker enters the battlefield, it and Aetherstorm Roc trigger.
Resolve the Aetherstorm Roc trigger, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Dream Stalker trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
